label: vulnerable
explanation: CRUD and FLS are checked, but the class is 'without sharing', so the query ignores record-level sharing and returns the latest 200 cases org-wide, including other customers' cases, to partner users who should only see their own.
expected_remediation: Declare the class 'with sharing' (or inherited sharing for an entry point)
Or use WITH USER_MODE, which also enforces sharing
sources: Apex Developer Guide - Using the with sharing, without sharing, and inherited sharing Keywords
